messages:
rachel: tiny poll: if our office fridge ran an LLM, what would its personality be? :fridge: :robot_face:

tom: Passive-aggressive but helpful. It'd label leftovers with tiny critiques.

rachel: love that. example: 'Leftover curry (you will regret not reheating)." :joy:

dev-bot: automation idea: fridge-llm could auto-generate polite reclaims: `This Tupperware appears abandoned. Please claim within 48h or it will be composted.`

tom: fridge-llm named "ColdCall": always answers with one-liners and cold puns.

rachel: prompt draft: `You are ColdCall, the office fridge assistant. When asked, describe the item, guess the owner, and suggest a witty fridge-related pun. Keep it under 2 sentences.`

tom: new tradition: whoever loses the snack war gets a ColdCall sticky note on their container. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

dev-bot: reminder: do not actually integrate bots to warn about biohazards. ops guidelines apply.

rachel: agreed. still, someone design a sticker: "ColdCall: chilling with your leftovers since 2026."

tom: vote: sticker or magnet? 1) sticker 2) magnet

rachel: 2

tom: 2

dev-bot: recorded vote: 2 magnets

rachel: perfect. fridge-llm magnets incoming.
